title: Abstract Instances
instructions: Can you create an instance of an abstract class using something like `val obj = MyAbstractClass()`?

options.text: Yes, abstract classes work like regular classes
Yes, but only if it has no abstract methods
No, you can only create instances of classes that extend the abstract class
No, abstract classes cannot have any methods

explanation: You cannot create an instance of an abstract class directly. Abstract classes are incomplete blueprints. You must create a child class that provides implementations for all abstract methods, and then create instances of that child class.
